source: Clever Real Estate study via Real Estate News

headline: Why listings are
*sitting longer*
slides.fig_caption: Median days on market in Sept. 2026, up from 27 in March 2022
slides.sub: A new study asked buyers, agents and online forums what keeps homes from selling.

slides.label: of would-be buyers say a long time on market makes a listing look *suspicious*
slides.body: From a survey of 1,000 adults planning to buy a home in the next five years.

slides.title: Price first, *then the rest*
points: Half of 2026 posts about stale listings urged *another price cut*, up from 38% in 2024.
Sellers who cut reported a median reduction of *$20,000*.
Suggestions to renovate or repaint rose *67%* from 2024 to 2026.
67% of buyers would choose a *better location* over a better home.

slides.title: Win it in *the first weeks*
slides.body: Agents themselves name overpricing as the top culprit. Set the price with fresh comps, fix what buyers will notice, and talk through a reduction plan before the days start piling up.
